name: DonorPerfect Donor
description: Provides a Drupal content entity (donorperfect_donor) mapping the DonorPerfect donor record (dp / dpudf tables), plus the donor search + address loading used by the base module's Name form element.
project_description: Submodule of the DonorPerfect integration project. Defines the donorperfect_donor Drupal content entity, whose records live in DonorPerfect (dp base table, dpudf user-defined-field table) and are read/written through the base module's DPQuery XML API client. Adds computed name_full and name_alpha fields and a DonorController that performs name/email/phone/address searches against DonorPerfect (used by the base module's Name form element) and eager-loads a donor's additional addresses. Requires the DonorPerfect base module.
